sentences.span: The FOMC raised the fed funds rate by 25bps to 3.75-4.00% as expected, with the unanimous decision accompanied by a more-hawkish-than-expected shift
sentences.why: 25bp to 3.75-4.00%, unanimous, all confirmed; 'first hike since 2023' independently confirmed in 16619, 16564, 16686.

sentences.span: a 16-2 majority projected at least one more hike this year, with four participants projecting two more hikes this year... There were no dissenting votes against today's hike
sentences.why: 16-2/four-projecting-two/no dissents all match. Goldman's own pre-meeting expectation of a Waller dissent is in 16593: 'We expect Governor Waller to dissent'.

sentences.span: Warsh's comments, who said both he and his colleagues were "hard-pressed" to describe policy as restrictive... today's action removed a "dose of accommodation."
sentences.why: Both quoted phrases attributed correctly to Warsh in the same source.

No source states or characterizes the market as taking the SEP projections 'at face value'; searched all FOMC-adjacent files for this framing and found none. Plausible narrative gloss with no textual support.

sentences.span: The median-longer run dot was revised up from 3.06% to 3.25%... this year revised down to 4.1%—a tenth under their estimate of the natural rate of unemployment
sentences.why: Both figures appear together in this JPM note; the 3.25% neutral estimate is separately confirmed in 16688 (Goldman) and the 4.1% unemployment figure separately in 16686 (Goldman Asia), supporting 'both' referring to two banks converging on the same SEP numbers.

sentences.span: Market pricing of the probability of further hikes this year rose 8pp to 51% for October and 9pp to 78% for December today
Today saw ~70% of NYSE volume in declining stocks.
we need to see sentiment become less complacent, more oversold conditions, and a higher-correlation index decline for us to think this correction has run its course
sentences.why: Accurate paraphrase: 'higher-correlation index decline' correctly rendered as stocks falling together rather than individually.

sentences.span: the S&P 500's Software Index rallied 3.2%, whereas the Semiconductor Index fell 4.4%
sentences.why: Exact figures, correct attribution (Raymond James's 'Up and Adam').

sentences.span: the response to Anthropic CEO Amodei's comments triggered the largest one-day move in the +Software / -Semis pair (JPPQSFSM Index) in its history, +12%
sentences.why: Correctly attributed to JPMorgan's own index; Amodei's 'call for slower development' independently confirmed in 16629 ('calls from AI leaders, including Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, to slow the rate of advancement').
No source document in the corpus mentions Wingstop, Darden, or 'long-only selling' anywhere; searched all files, zero hits. Fabricated detail.

sentences.span: Mean time to exploit has collapsed, in some cases inflecting negative as adversaries weaponize vulnerabilities before patches exist.
sentences.why: The directional claim (mean time to exploit collapsing, going negative) is JPMorgan's and correctly attributed, but the specific figures (-7 days in 2025, 63 days in 2018, 132 new vulnerabilities/day, 16% fixed/month) appear nowhere in this document or any other file in the corpus — invented statistics bolted onto a real qualitative claim.

sentences.span: Driven by inflation fears as Brent crude surged past $109/bbl, the 10-year US Treasury yield crossed the 5% threshold... Gold also plunged over 2%, slipping below $4,300/oz
sentences.why: Figure and causal framing (oil-driven inflation scare firming hike odds) both directly supported.

sentences.span: GS favors cheap upside convexity. Call skew and risk reversals are not pricing much upside tail risk, while GLD gamma could amplify the move.
sentences.why: 'Dealer positioning in GLD options' is a fair technical rendering of 'GLD gamma' (dealer gamma exposure); trade framing (cheap upside vs. spot) matches.

sentences.span: Currently, the GOP has a 53 - 47 majority in the Senate. The focus is on whether Democrats can flip 4 Senate seats with the most likely opportunities being in Alaska, Iowa, Maine, North Carolina, Ohio, and Texas.
sentences.why: Exact match on Senate composition and all six named states.
